name: Miracles Of Christ The
overview: The miracles of Christ demonstrate His divine authority and compassion as He healed all manner of sickness and disease among the people, as recorded in Matthew 4:23-24. His power over physical and spiritual afflictions is evident in acts such as cleansing lepers and healing the sick, including Peter's mother-in-law, who was freed from fever through His touch (Matthew 8:3, 14-15). These miracles not only confirmed His identity as the Messiah but also revealed His heart for restoration and the inbreaking of God's kingdom into the lives of those who believed.
